measurement.standardization: train-only, hierarchical-weighted mean and weighted population SD; zero SD set to 1
measurement.solver: SciPy scipy.optimize.minimize, L-BFGS-B; maxiter=2000; default ftol/gtol; unsuccessful minimize result abort

training.weights: hierarchical equal source -> block -> truth class -> relation mass; helper weights are mean-normalized, then normalized to sum=1 before weighted standardization and logistic-loss fitting
training.inner_objective: source-macro mean block-level D x P F credit
training.objective: weighted mean logistic loss + 0.5 * lambda * L2(beta)^2; intercept unpenalized

scoring.F_credit: 1 when held-out disrupting score exceeds preserving score by more than tie_tolerance; 0 within tolerance; -1 otherwise
scoring.ci: sorted order statistics at int(0.025*(n-1)) and int(0.975*(n-1))
